reviews.t: This is such a great lotion!
reviews.x: This is such a great lotion!!! It has a faint clean cucumber smell and is so rich and moisturizing. I bought these at Target originally, but was so relieved that amazon started selling them when target stopped. I am picky with lotion and scents and this one is my favorite of all time.

reviews.t: Bought for bf but I like it too

He has sensitive skin but also doesn’t like his products to smell too feminine. Well, after a few days of use, I think it’s safe to say my bf is sold. reviews.t: This lotion has the perfect viscosity for coverage and my skin absorbs it very ...
reviews.x: This lotion has the perfect viscosity for coverage and my skin absorbs it very well. Skin is moisturized daily w/o feeling slick/greasy and w/o intrusive perfume/scent. Best lotion out there!

reviews.t: Great lotion and manufacturer
reviews.x: Great product and amazing service from Marlowe.  I’ve used both the scented and unscented (sensitive) versions of this lotion. The scent is a little different from others I’ve experienced but it’s not off putting. I would say it’s a gender neutral scent. I’ve determined I prefer the unscented before bed but either is good during the day. The lotion itself seems to work well and is thick but not greasy at all. Overall I’m happy with my purchase and interaction with the manufacturer. I looking for

reviews.t: Perfect simple lotion
reviews.x: I have missed this all my life... This is the perfect no-nonsense lotion. No chemicals, no allergens, no petroleum, no dimethicone, no unnecessary junk, no greasy after-feel, no fragrances.... Finally, a simple effective lotion that contains nothing I dislike. And it doesn’t sting or burn at all when I apply it to dry and cracked skin. I hope they never change their formula.

reviews.t: Light fragrance very refreshing!
reviews.x: Light fragrance very refreshing! I recommended this lotion to my friends. I’m very sensitive to fragrances so was delighted to find this scent  refreshing and light, maybe a touch of lime and lemon grass.  No greasy residue either.

reviews.t: Great Lotion!
reviews.x: I hadn't heard of this brand but so glad I took a chance on it! I love it. It really helps my very dry skin, has a great light scent & you get that silky feel on your skin after applying it. I love this stuff!

reviews.t: Good Stuff
reviews.x: Excellent lotion for entire body including face.  Light weight, not greasy, very light fragranced.  Recommend & will buy again!

reviews.t: I really like this lotion.
reviews.x: This is marketed as a men’s product, but it’s really unisex. The sent has a very light, cucumber based scent, which I love because it does not overpower your cologne. It’s very rich, so it takes more to cover your surface area, versus say vasoline intensive care for example.  Unlike most otc lotions however, this moisturizes without the sticky/clammy feel (which women hate btw)!  Moisturizer lasts several hours, maybe all day, honestly I take multiple showers per day so I cannot attest to it las

reviews.t: the fine print on the bottle makes it is hard to ...
reviews.x: While they stressed the natural products,  the fine print on the bottle makes it is hard to read that synthetic materials are also used.  I expected it to be all natural ingredients, pretty disappointed. Of course one should keep in mind that  nasty crude oil is also natural  and that some synthetics (to be fair) are better than some natural ingradients.

reviews.t: Best lotion for very sensitive skin
reviews.x: I have eczema on my hands so lotions with fragrance and chemicals irritate my hands. I had been looking for a lotion that moisturizes all day and doesn’t irritate my skin. It took three months to get to the bottom of the bottle so it lasts a very long time and that was with my husband using it as well. The product is definitely worth the money!

reviews.t: Yuck.
reviews.x: Firstly, I thought that this was a men's product.  Those are dudes in the product info right?  This product does not have a manly scent at all.  It smells like a cross between granny's Dove bar soap and her Jurgen's lotion.  It's so overpowering that I have to leave the bathroom for a larger space in order to apply it. reviews.t: This is nice, non greasy
reviews.x: This is nice, non greasy, absorbs well, has a light non-overwhelming scent. It's not super moisturizing, but good for everyday lotion.

reviews.t: My skin is the softest it's ever been
reviews.x: So happy I stumbled across this lotion on Amazon. I usually use Nivea's Skim Firming Lotion (in which I still use from time to time) but as of lately, it has started to dry out my skin. During the winter, I have to find lotions that actually keep my skin hydrated/moisturized and this is it. It's non-greasy, light weight and has an airy scent. I'm going to purchase a bottle just to keep at my desk for work. Love this stuff.

reviews.t: Quality product, smells nice, all-natural skin care
reviews.x: Smells good, thick enough for most daily use cases. In the worst of winter temperatures, I have to supplement with intensive care body lotion to avoid rough skin. Good size for the price and the pump hasn't clogged on me yet.

reviews.t: I like using this all day long.
reviews.x: I think my skin is beyond redemption from working outside, desert gardening and working inside, housecleaning.  But it does feel nice on the skin and has a delightful fragrance.

reviews.t: Fragrance free!
reviews.x: I love this lotion because most lotions have some kind fragrance and that brother my allergies. This is fragrance free and keep my hands moist throughout the day!

reviews.t: Five Stars
reviews.x: Love this Stuff ... Was a Target product that is no longer available at Target stores.

reviews.t: Failure of execution, unless you're talking about sense of smell.
reviews.x: To be absolutely fair, this absorbs well, has a good texture, and feels light. That being said it smells horrid, like a generic drugstore lotion my boyfriend had held onto for a few years before I finally chucked it out of the medicine cabinet. This product also fails in its basic function, as it's a moisturizer that does not moisturize. I retired it after two days of use, during which my dry problem areas regressed from flaky to scaly. reviews.t: BEST Lotion and Fav Product from this Brand
reviews.x: I've been looking for a lotion that can help me out with my dry skin, comes with a pump, and works well after a shower but isn't too damp when rubbed in (the important thing that most lotions do). I haven't noticed any extra dampness from this and that seals the deal for me. The aesthetic is nice too. My only complaint (but its not really one so I'm giving 5 stars) is the smell. It smells like lotion but a bit too much like sunscreen imo. Maybe I'm just use to zero scent but it feels a bit stron

reviews.t: floral scent delicate soft texture moisturizer
reviews.x: The texture is as smooth as silk.  The moisturizer does leave a cool feel on my dry skin.  I like the delicate, light feel of this lotion not "wet" like other lotion brands yet it provides the softness on my skin.  The scent is  light yet lingering like aroma from a bouquet of spring flowers, soft perfume makes you feel sophisticated and beautiful.  You forget that the moisturizer is working for you while wearing it.  Though the ingredient contains deep sea algae extract, the scent is am

reviews.t: I love this product as a replacement for the lotions I ...
reviews.x: I love this product as a replacement for the lotions I used to use that were full of chemicals and other toxins. This feels smooth and doesn't bother my sensitive skin. My only complaint would be the bottle. All pump tops become essentially useless toward the end and never seem to draw product as you near empty... but this one seems to quit while the bottle is still half full. I have bought this same product several times, so I know it wasn't just a one time issue. Other than less than an optima

reviews.t: Love this body lotion
reviews.x: I love this moisturizer! It smells great, provides the perfect amount of moisture for a body lotion (not as heavy as hand cream, not so light as to not moisturize well), is well priced, and the container is nice looking and a functional design (e.g. it fits in the cabinet well and doesn’t tip over when you pump it). Clearly I have some opinions on products and this one is a winner. Thank you!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the lotion for being non-greasy and absorbing well without a slick after-feel.
Many reviewers describe the scent as light and pleasant, though a few find it overpowering or not what they expected.
Reviewers commonly report the lotion is rich and moisturizing, especially helpful for dry or sensitive skin.
Several reviewers appreciate that it is gentle and suitable for sensitive skin, with some noting it doesn't sting or irritate.
A few reviewers mention the product is marketed toward men but is actually unisex in scent.

qa.q: Is it greasy or does it absorb quickly?
qa.answer: Reviews say it is non-greasy and absorbs well [1][2][3][5], with one noting it rubs in without extra dampness [6].

claims.text: It rubs in without leaving extra dampness.

qa.q: How long does the moisturizing effect last?
qa.answer: One review states the moisturizer lasts several hours [1], but no other review specifies a duration for the moisturizing effect.

qa.q: Is the scent strong or light?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on scent strength: some describe it as light [1][2][6], while another calls it overpowering [3].

However, one reviewer notes a fragrance [3], so those sensitive to scent may want to consider that.
